subject: AuroraBank TAM coverage windows, escalation SLAs and incident comms — RFP Q&A
messages:
From: Samantha Reid <s.reid@aurorabank.com>

Cc: David Cho <dcho_procurement@aurorabank.com>
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AuroraBank RFP — clarifications on TAM coverage & incident notifications

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the RFP materials — we have a short list of clarifying questions from procurement and operations around support windows and escalation behavior. Can you confirm the following so we can move the support exhibit to legal?

1) TAM coverage windows: what local business hours support does Redwood guarantee per the Dedicated tier? We need local US Eastern overlap with our ops team (0800–2000 ET).
2) After-hours escalation: what is the expected response and acknowledgement SLA for Sev 1 and Sev 2 incidents? Are there guaranteed follow-up intervals?
3) Incident communications: what templates and channels (email, phone, PagerDuty) do you use for incident updates and RCA delivery cadence?
4) Roster & continuity: can you provide a TAM roster with primary/backups and on-call handoff notes we can attach to the SOW?

We'd like answers in-line and the roster before Friday 18 May to align with our internal review. Appreciate a short call if helpful.

Best,
Samantha Reid
Head of Vendor Ops — AuroraBank

--

All,

Attached is a first-pass TAM roster (AuroraBank_TAM_Roster_v1.xlsx). Highlights:

- Coverage windows (Dedicated): Primary TAM support 08:00–20:00 ET (Mon–Fri) to match Aurora ops; weekend business-hours coverage (09:00–17:00 ET) available as an add-on.

Subject: Re: AuroraBank RFP — clarifications on TAM coverage & incident notifications

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear list. Answers below; attaching the TAM roster and the SLA exhibit for legal.

1) TAM coverage windows
- Redwood Dedicated: Primary TAM coverage 08:00–20:00 ET, Monday–Friday (matches your requested overlap). This is staffed by named TAMs with role-based backups by default. Weekend business-hours coverage (09:00–17:00 ET) is available as an add-on (we've indicated it as optional in the roster).

2) After-hours escalation (Sev definitions beneath)
- Sev 1 (service down / critical production impact): Acknowledgement within 30 minutes, initial mitigation update within 60 minutes, hourly updates until mitigated. Escalation path: TAM -> Platform On-Call -> SRE Lead -> Dedicated Support Director.
- Sev 2 (major degradation / partial outage): Acknowledgement within 2 hours, follow-up every 4 hours until resolved. Escalation path: TAM -> Platform On-Call -> Engineering Manager.

3) Incident communications
- Channels: primary incident channel is PagerDuty for alerts + a dedicated Slack channel (or MS Teams) for real-time ops; email for formal status updates and RCA delivery.
- Templates: we provide status update templates (Initial, Interim, Resolved) and an RCA template with a 5-business-day target for substantive RCAs; preliminary root-cause summary within 72 hours if the incident requires deeper investigation.

4) Roster & continuity
- Attached: AuroraBank_TAM_Roster_v1.xlsx (primary/backups, shift windows, handoff notes). We include a shadowing week for any TAM change and a named backup for every primary unless you prefer role-based backups.

Next steps:
- Please confirm whether Aurora wants weekend coverage as an add-on and whether you prefer named backups for all TAMs.
- If that looks good, we can attach Redwood_Support_SLA_Exhibit.pdf to the SOW and schedule a 30-minute legal ops call.

I've attached both the roster and the SLA exhibit to this reply. Happy to jump on a call tomorrow if helpful.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: AuroraBank_TAM_Roster_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), Redwood_Support_SLA_Exhibit.pdf (pdf)
